# Headline tables (generated by analysis/headline.py; do not edit by hand)

Cells: speedup vs native FP64 and path. Plain number = event time with workspace set (`*_ws`) or pool kept (`*_kp`); `w` = zero-code wall clock (`*_ws0`) vs native wall clock. Native column = native time. Baseline = the native mode of the same config; `*` = no native mode in that grid, baseline is the bench's per-row PEDANTIC reference instead (can be slower than the native mode on small shapes); `path` = path-only row (no timing reference). Bits: emulated rows; `fb:N` = bits reported on rows that fell back at runtime.

## P2a decision map: which path does each strategy take?

P2a is path-only by design (`--no-ref --no-wall`, 1 repeat): no native reference per point. Where the default heuristic declines, `default_ws` *is* native, so EAGER/native = default_ws/eager_ws measures what the heuristic leaves on the table. Speedups where the default emulates come from P1b.

| GPU | points | default emulates | default declines | of those EAGER emulates | EAGER faster (s>1) | s>1.5 | EAGER slower (s<1) | EAGER declines too | default fallback | smallest min(m,n,k) default emulates |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RTX 3090 (sm_86) | 290 | 0 | 290 | 290 | 123 | 109 | 167 | 0 | 0 | - |
| RTX 4090 (sm_89) | 290 | 90 | 200 | 200 | 25 | 15 | 175 | 0 | 0 | 181 |
| RTX 5060 Ti (sm_120) | 287 | 74 | 213 | 198 | 41 | 29 | 157 | 15 | 0 | 181 |

## P4 nsys path check: GEMM calls that entered emulation, and how many fell back at runtime

One profiled pass over all (l, q) per matrix and mode. Entered = instances of the `cublasLt_imma_emu::…d884gemm` kernel (launched once per emulated call; exits in ~2 µs unless ADP falls back). Fell back = instances of a variant whose minimum duration is > 100 µs (`mixed` if a variant has both short and long instances). Emulation share = GPU time in emulation kernels.
